name: Shape Analogies
blurb: The first two shapes change. Change the third one the same way.
childIntro: Look at the first two shapes. Something happened to turn the first one into the second. Make that same thing happen to the third shape.
howItWorks: Figure A becomes figure B. The child works out what happened and applies it to figure C. This runs at every OLSAT level from kindergarten to grade 12. At the lower levels one thing changes; by the upper levels two or three change at once.
parentTip: Ask your child to say the change as a short sentence before looking at the answers. It flipped over. It got smaller and turned grey. Children who look at the answers first tend to pick whichever one merely looks similar.
